protocol.procedure: Analyze public failure logs to identify oscillation patterns. Prioritize coverage gaps and deadline violations. Generate a branch-and-dispatch workflow that dynamically routes tasks based on diagnostic signals while preserving memory of best practices and failures.

parent.procedure: Use public failure evidence to propose one reusable branch-and-dispatch workflow. Respect the DSL grammar.
